description:
A junior administrator accidentally deleted the 'greenleaf-organics.test' virtual server. Your task is to restore it from the backup archive located at '/home/ga/backups/greenleaf-organics-backup.tar.gz'.

1. Navigate to the 'Backup and Restore' > 'Restore Virtual Servers' page in Virtualmin (https://localhost:10000).
2. Select the backup file from the local path provided above.
3. Restore the virtual server with all its features (Web, DNS, Mail, MySQL) enabled.
4. Verify the restoration is complete.
